data.narrative:
Unconventional AI is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Naveen Rao, Michael Carbin, Sara Achour, and MeeLan Lee, having raised $475M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector includes 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers, though narrow peer-matching within the Seed stage proved insufficient to support median-based valuation.

Stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation lever. Using total capital raised ($475M) as a proxy for post-money value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $1.2B. A sensitivity range around this estimate—accounting for variance in round timing and market conditions—produces a low of $1.0B (2.1x multiplier) and high of $1.4B (2.9x multiplier).

Public-comp anchoring via the Semiconductors sector's 21.5x median price-to-sales multiple cannot be applied without revenue disclosure. Peer-median triangulation fails due to insufficient same- or adjacent-stage private comparables in the narrow semiconductor chip space. The valuation range of $1.0B–$1.4B (median $1.2B) rests on a single method and reflects material uncertainty around capital efficiency, burn rate, and competitive positioning relative to named peers including Cerebras, SambaNova, and Etched.
